canonical_result_schema.determinism_rule: A normalized fixture has one vector_id/parameter_id and one expected tuple. The checker returns exactly one tuple after fixed-precedence load checks, then a disjoint replay-gate partition, then deterministic extend/outcome evaluation.

load_precedence: if stream_identity/record_version/summary_version is outside the frozen fixture domain -> RESUME_REJECT(domain_or_version_mismatch)
if rows_seen==0 and any of next_ordinal!=0, last_consumed_ordinal!=null, tail!=null, last_row_identity!=null -> RESUME_REJECT(empty_prefix_inconsistent)
if rows_seen>0 and either next_ordinal!=rows_seen or last_consumed_ordinal!=rows_seen-1 -> RESUME_REJECT(cursor_summary_mismatch)
if defects/first_rejection violate empty/nonempty equivalence or canonical-minimum relation -> RESUME_REJECT(defect_cache_mismatch)
transition_and_outcome: NOOP_DUPLICATE invokes extend zero times; when the vector includes the following next_ordinal row, that following row invokes extend exactly once.
Any load/replay rejection invokes extend zero times and returns outcome NOT_EVALUATED.

For accepted traces, Omega is computed only from restored/extended S: FAIL if fail_seen; else UNKNOWN if unknown_seen; else PASS iff terminal_q satisfies b&r&f&s; else UNRESOLVED. Diagnostic INVALID remains orthogonal.

classification_proof.load_totality: On normalized one-fault fixtures, fixed precedence makes load a total function. CR13, CR6, CR5, CR9, CR4, and CR7 occupy disjoint isolated-fault classes; all remaining fixtures reach RESUME_OK.
classification_proof.replay_partition: Conditioned on RESUME_OK with an incoming row, ordinal==last_consumed partitions by identity equality into duplicate versus conflicting replay; every other ordinal partitions into next_ordinal versus discontinuity. These cases are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
classification_proof.transition_uniqueness: The replay-gate result fixes extend count: zero on rejection/duplicate, one on ACCEPT_NEXT, except CR1's explicitly two-delivery trace whose canonical sequence is duplicate-noop followed by one next-row extend; suffix vectors apply the same rule per row.
classification_proof.outcome_uniqueness: For every accepted final S, FAIL > UNKNOWN > PASS > UNRESOLVED is a total ordered semantic rule, while diagnostic INVALID is orthogonal. Therefore each normalized CR fixture has exactly one expected classification tuple without external state.

newly_discovered_gap.why_CR8_CR13_do_not_isolate_it: CR8 proves that a valid predecessor tail is semantically used across the restart boundary; it does not present an internally inconsistent tail/last_row_identity checkpoint. newly_discovered_gap.consequence: The pseudo-checker is deterministic for all CR0-CR13 fixtures, but the predecessor statement that CR0-CR13 isolate every persistence-contract invariant is not proven as written. Either make boundary linkage part of a trusted atomic-envelope identity whose verification is explicit, or add an isolated boundary-link corruption vector and load rejection code before retaining the minimality/sufficiency claim.
